up: Return the list of distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5060014. For each molecule, output its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). First find the document in the docs table using docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5060014', then join through compound_records on doc_id to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and left join compound_structures on molregno. Ensure that only molecules directly associated with that document are included. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5060014';
